scenes.text: Every tuna tells a story. A story of quality, freshness, and value.
But determining that quality requires experience, precision, and a trained eye. Expert graders examine critical visual indicators, including sashibo core and tail-cut.
Their expertise matters. But what if technology could help make grading more consistent, efficient, and accessible?
Introducing Tuna Eye. A computer vision-powered tuna quality grading system designed to support expert judgment.
Powered by MobileNet V three, Tuna Eye analyzes sashibo-core and tail-cut images, examining visual characteristics such as color and clarity.
With a guided kiosk interface, users select samples, record weight, capture images, and review each step before analysis.
Grade A. Grade B. Grade C. Or Invalid when the image cannot be reliably classified. Each result includes confidence to support interpretation.
Because Tuna Eye doesn't replace expert judgment. It supports review, documents results, and extends expert-informed grading into a streamlined digital workflow.
